description: Submit YOUR (Claude's) response for the current round of an interactive brainstorm session. After the brainstorm tool returns external models' responses, call this tool with your substantive contribution. Read all responses carefully and engage with specific points — agree, disagree, build upon, or challenge ideas. Do not just summarize. After your response, the next round runs automatically (or synthesis if final round).

response.description: Your substantive contribution to this round of the debate. Engage deeply with the other models' responses. Minimum 50 characters.

session_id.description: The session ID returned by the brainstorm tool

name: brainstorm_respond
